gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-carian: Luckiest Guy has a mean, high-set line and ink that looks poured at a single width. Noto Sans Carian follows with open, scissor-blade terminals and tiny gaps under its ascenders, so the loud heading gets a tidy partner.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-chakma:
Luckiest Guy shouts cheerfully, its ink poured at a single width.

Noto Sans Chakma does the quieter job, packing lowercase up toward the caps with open, uncrowded mouths on its s and c, while the heading handles the noise.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-cham:
Luckiest Guy is loud, cheerful and set high on the line.

Noto Sans Cham sits beside it like a modern, clean plain sans, tall and rounded, giving the heading's rope-like strokes a gentler, more open neighbor.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Loud, cheerful and slammed together, with a tall band of letters under a heavy headline. Noto Sans Cherokee keeps it approachable.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-chorasmian: Noto Sans Chorasmian reads contemporary and plain sans, its curves stopping short instead of closing in, with short ascenders over a large x-height. And Luckiest Guy above it keeps one unshaded line, so a long passage moves along without any brush-like swelling.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-coptic:
Noto Sans Coptic is clean and contemporary.

Its middle zone dominates each line, with open mouths on the s and c, while Luckiest Guy brings a plain, unshaded line that never swells; use the heading big and the text modestly.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-cuneiform:
Noto Sans Cuneiform reads clean and contemporary.

Its e opens up instead of closing, and the lowercase swells like inflated glass beads, which sets off Luckiest Guy, whose bold and light strokes never mix within a word.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-devanagari: Noto Sans Devanagari reads neutral and modern, with an open lower curve on the g and capitals that blend into a compact lowercase skyline. Luckiest Guy earns its keep big and short, its plain, unshaded lines doing the shouting.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-duployan: Cheerful and loud, Luckiest Guy draws every letter with one constant line width. And Noto Sans Duployan answers in a contemporary, plain sans, its oversized a and e counters wide open, so the text can sit comfortably smaller.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-elbasan:
Cheerful and loud, Luckiest Guy hits with diagonals as heavy as its verticals.

Noto Sans Elbasan then reads contemporary over a stretch, its large lowercase forms and open terminals never pinching shut, which keeps the text moving smoothly.
